literalGroups.primaryGround: UNESCO describes the Great Barrier Reef as the world’s largest coral-reef collection/ecosystem (L5,L50,L63) and says about 99% of its World Heritage Area lies in the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park (L82-L85). The prompt asks for an Australian marine park. All four options are Australian marine parks; all distractors protect real reef systems or true coral reef habitat: Coral Sea has 34 reef areas and 15,000 km² reef systems; Ningaloo is one of the largest fringing reefs; Lord Howe has the world’s southernmost true coral reef. Parenthetical regions are consistently formatted and supported by primary locators. Only GBR is the world-largest system.
